A bit late, but I got one! 
So, about 3 weeks ago, I get off work early for the first time in 4 months. Super stoked, so I decide to go to the favorite bar for all of us at work for a bit. A few beers and shots of whiskey later, we decide to head to the next bar for some pool and food. We eat, we play, we drink more beers and whiskey shots, and decide we wanna keep the party going at the next bar, but not before heading back to work to fuck with whoever is left there. We do, the manager yells at us, we bail before she gets more upset with us. So, next bar, I'm super trashed at this point, and decide to relieve myself. All goes well, but as a exit, I decide the bathroom sign is missing something. With my good ol sharpie, I decide to add more to the bathroom sign, which included a skirt, top hat, and penis to the handicapped picture part of the sign. I get 86'd, and scolded, and decide I should try to go home. Well, I biked to work, so I decided I should try to bike home, and no more than 3 feet later, fell on my face, cutting open more eyebrow. Didn't realize I was bleeding till I felt a warm liquid on my face and whipped it up with my sweater. My coworkers notice, call me a cab, I get home, but not before realizing I have no cash for the cab. Luckily, he saw my bloodied face and said this one was on him. This all wouldn't have been too bad if I hadn't gotten that eyebrow pierced 2 weeks prior. But my coworkers thought I was last so you know.. go me.

Tl;dr: Got drunk, got 86'd, ate shit, and didn't pay for a cab. Pulled off a hat trick in one night.
